content.short: Token Metrics is an AI-driven crypto research platform that turns data into actionable investment insights.
content.description: Token Metrics is an AI-driven crypto research platform that converts data into actionable investment insights. Users gain access to concise analytics on their favorite cryptocurrency projects and can identify top assets across various categories. Developers can integrate analytics into their dapps via Token Metrics APIs. The platform features a Bull vs. Bear indicator to gauge overall asset interest. With a community of about 90,000 members, 5,000 users, and a footprint in 50+ countries, Token Metrics offers broad web3 analytics.
